independentProbes: The reviewer's own reaction-limited bot, reading only public state, cleared 334 of 352 garden runs at 0.25 s lag and 304 of 352 at 0.35 s with 7.5 decisions per second (round 3); after the round-4 change it cleared gardens 8-12 at 15-16 of 16 and 13-16 of 16. Idle, mash and random keys won 0 of 440. With the reviewer's own seeds, the owner's greedy bot beats 8 of 22 gardens and none of 15-22 above half; informed-random wins garden 9 12% and garden 11 40% of 100 runs. Fuzz of 162 solo and duel runs with hostile dt and pointer values broke no invariant; 88 runs matched across 30, 60 and 120 Hz; 112 barrel-preview trials matched the real blast.

findings.observation: Only 6 gardens and no select or continue. There are now 22 data-driven gardens that introduce bombers, upgrades, scouts, walls, wardens, wet soil and compost barrels one at a time, with per-garden bilingual tips, a garden select and env.progress continue; missing, junk and throwing stores are safe.

Dead resolveBlastChain was deleted and its test rewritten against the real engine; a quality suite now covers time-outs, duel results, Chinese and touch-only play, blind and greedy bars over 20 seeds, reaction-limited clears at 30, 60 and 120 Hz and a rising curve.

Round 2: the greedy bar held only for a lucky seed set (garden 17 at 80%, gardens 12-14 at 100%). Gardens were retuned and the bars run on 20 seeds; garden 17 is now about 30% pooled and gardens 12-14 range from 0% to 55%.
Round 2: garden 14 cleared only 6 of 16 for a slow human-like bot and garden 11 opened with a repeatable ambush. Both were softened and given tips; they now clear 12-16 of 16.
Round 3: informed-random won garden 9 about 53% of 220 runs. Gardens 9 and 11 gained a bomber rival; a 100-run test caps both at 45%.

Barrel range-2 chains are previewed in orange with brighter dots; fuse, HUD and objective text are accurate; tips for gardens 3, 15 and 19 were corrected; rivals no longer pick up authored upgrades and upgrades survive later blasts; ROLES, FEATURES, DIRS and MENU are frozen; the 1,219-line file is split into four modules.

openNotes: Garden 3's lone scout can seal itself behind crates; bots that do not blast in time out on 4 of 16 runs, and the tip tells players to blast crates to reach it.
The greedy bot beats garden 11 about half the time and garden 12 slightly more; informed-random sits at 40% on garden 11 against a 45% test ceiling.
Greedy fails every garden built around a scout or warden, so the reaction-limited bot is the better gauge of the curve, which rises with dips at gardens 5 and 17.
The quality suite takes about 5-6 minutes.
A duel P2 win is reported as won: false, following the other two-player games.
